name: GoldReserve profit claim keyed on current NFT balance
summary: GoldReserve.claimProfit() pays (NFTs held now x accumulatedProfitPerNFT) minus what that address already claimed, so an address that receives NFTs is paid the whole profit history on them. With flash-loaned BNB the attacker deposited profit, minted 8 NFTs and moved them through 23 fresh holders that each claimed the full accrual, recovering its deposit plus the 12.75 BNB of mint proceeds the contract held; copycats repeated it with one minted NFT and two claimers.
notes: Before the anchor nobody had called claimProfit or depositProfit (accumulatedProfitPerNFT was 0) and the contract's only outflows were the owner's withdraw() calls. The campaign is eleven copycat transactions from 0x160ee9bb, 0xc20d585f and 0xd4f04374, each netting 0.75 BNB of fresh mint proceeds. Loss is the contract's net BNB outflow per transaction; the attacker's own deposit nets out within the anchor (rule 11).
